Discontinued Frameset-Does NOT Include the Rotor Guard. No completes available, framesets only.

Powder coated your choice of stock color (see below and put color choice in checkout notes). 8-10 week turnaround for framesets.

For years now, Milwaukee Bicycle Company has been a trailblazer of innovation in the growing sport of hardcourt bike polo. At the very heart of our contribution is the Polo Bruiser; some of the best polo players in the world now call on this bike when it’s time to take the court. During its engineering and design, we took continuous feedback from some of polo’s most skilled players, and not surprisingly, the end product has become a favorite of North American and World Champions alike.

The Polo Bruiser is crafted from light and stiff American-made True Temper OX Platinum tubing. The geometry was tweaked to specifically accommodate the motions and riding style of the sport, most notably a shortening of the top tube. It boasts a 35mm tire clearance and can be completed with a v-brake or disc brake fork option. Why spend this much on a bike you’re just going to bang up on the court? The answer lies in the quiet reflection following defeat. If you play polo to compete, to challenge yourself, to play each match better than your last, then without a doubt, you’ve found your bike.

Current turn-around for a frameset is 8-10 weeks. This could be extended depending on options chosen. Please ask.

FEATURES AND INFORMATION

Designed And Developed By Milwaukee Bicycle Co. - Handmade By Waterford Precision Cycles*

TUBING

With complete True Temper OX Platinum this lightweight, high-end, hand crafted polo steed is no stranger to the podium. With North American and World Championship wins under its belt, you know that this frame is 3-2-1 POLO! ready.

PART INTEGRATION SPECS

68mm Threaded Bottom Bracket Shell

1-1/8" Headtube

Rear Linear Pull Brake

27.2mm Seatpost

28.6mm Seat Clamp

Custom Laser Rear Dropouts

120mm Rear Hub Spacing

TIRE CLEARANCE

Clearance for 37c Tires.

BRAKE CABLE ROUTING

Top Tube Underside Brake Cable Routing.

STOCK DERAILLEUR ROUTING

N/A

BRAZE-ONS

Top Tube Brake Cable Guides

Stainless Steel Milwaukee Headbadge, Milwaukee Script And WI State Badges

FORK COMPATIBILITY

Milwaukee Unicrown Polo Disc Fork

400mm Axle-Crown

30mm Rake

180mm Disc Brake Compatible

Custom Laser Cut 3-Point Fork Mounted Disc Guard NOT Included
